title: I could not be more disappointed than I am in the Hoover Air Cordless Series ...
text:
I could not be more disappointed than I am in the Hoover Air Cordless Series .... I could not be more disappointed than I am in the Hoover Air Cordless Series 3.0 Bagless Upright! In the past I have owned the Hoover Linx Windtunnel, given it as a gift, and never thought of making a change. In November of 2014, I went to Amazon basically to see if I could order a replacement rubber grip portion of the handle ( the clear covering has peeled away, making it uncomfortable to hold for long) and I got distracted reading the information on the newer Hoover cordless; I wound-up buying two: one for myself and one for my daughter. Sad to say, both of us detest this machine for the following reasons:
- It is way too heavy; very heavy for the purpose of fast, cordless clean-up.
- The brush mode is seldom operative.
- The attachments are confusing.
- The whole machine is awkward & unpleasant to use. I seldom use the word 'hate', but I do hate the Hoover Air Cordless Series 3.0 Upright.

WindTunnel 3 Technology - three channels of suction to lift and remove deep-down, embedded dirt
Lightweight and Steerable Technology - weighs less than 10 lbs allowing you to clean around furniture with ease
Multi-Floor Cleaning - easily clean from carpet to hard floors. Cleaning Path-11 In , enough to clean a 2,500 square foot home!
Reusable Easy Rinse Filter - rinse the filter to maintain the power to clean
description: UNLEASHED. We removed the cord but kept everything else. Finally, a full-size, cordless, cyclonic vacuum that can clean your whole home*. Two LithiumLife batteries provide an average of 50 minutes of fade-free power to clean both carpets and hard floors. That’s enough to clean a 2,500 square foot home with no loss of suction** and without recharging. WindTunnel 3 technology allows you to clean deep with three nozzle channels of powerful suction to capture dirt — other vacuums rely on one. The Air Cordless vacuum contains all the technology you'd expect to find in a Hoover upright, minus the cord. A simple change that changes everything. *With two LithiumLife batteries, get up to 2,500 square feet of carpet, hard-floor and above floor cleaning with removable wand. **Per IEC60312-1 1st Edition, Clause 5.9.
